decisions.reason: The candidate already records the same three current locations and dedicated-page model from message 54; the selector update requires no additional state change.
Adding explicit location-selector options does not change the master site's national role, positioning, or booking-handling state.
The current selector options do not alter the reusable-template or future-location expansion requirements already recorded from message 54.
The selector update does not change the separate Wix-site architecture, and the source state continues to route selected locations to their separate Wix websites.
The candidate already includes the Location Selector as a homepage section; enumerating its options does not change the homepage section composition.
The location-selector options do not change the visual style, design benchmark, navigation style, or cross-location design consistency.
The selector's current locations do not change the brand name, colors, cross-location branding, or national positioning.
Allowing visitors to select among current locations does not change Wix as the booking platform or the rule that sibling location sites host bookings.
The selector options do not alter the mobile-friendly responsive-design requirement.
Location selection on the homepage does not alter the separate booking, revenue, sales, calendar, or reporting data requirements.
The selector update does not change separate payout handling or the location-specific Wix payment-isolation mechanism.
The current location options do not modify the requirement to retain packages and prices across reused location-site formats.
